text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Terra

name: Gemma

name: Gemma
text: got it.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Sonnet is gone. Sonnet's card stays face down.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the citizen, Haiku the citizen, Gemma the killer, Sol the killer, Luna the officer, Terra the doctor.

Luna opened Day 1 by pressing Sol on nothing but tone, and Gemma, a killer, piled on with her. The town voted Gemma out, which was right, but Luna was killed on Night 2. On Day 2, Sol turned Sonnet's early push against Luna into suspicion of Sonnet, and Terra's mix-up over who had backed whom led the town to vote out Haiku, a citizen. Sonnet was killed on Night 3, leaving Sol and Gemma against only Terra, so the killers won.
